definitions.explanation: The large thick-skinned herbivore of Africa and Asia with one or two horns on its nose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧サイ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a rhino at the zoo.

examples.japanese: サイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A rhino's horn is made of the same substance as skin (keratin).

examples.japanese: サイ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}った→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{密猟|みつりょう}→密猟：15700_mitsuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれている→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧。
examples.english: Rhinos have been driven to the brink of extinction by poaching for their horns.

notes:
Written in katakana to tell it apart from the many Sino-Japanese words read さい; the kanji spelling {犀|さい} is rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧: rhino horn
- シロサイ / クロサイ: white rhino / black rhino
- インドサイ: Indian rhinoceros

USAGE:
サイ is short and easily confused in speech with {才|さい} (years of age) or ⟦{差異|さい}→差異：12411_sai⟧ (difference); context or the full phrase (サイ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧) makes it clear.
